title: デビュー戦の後に・はじめて！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara places first for the first time ever! Her desire to enter more races is stronger than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On her way home, Haru Urara spots her shopping district friends, and they unveil a banner they made to celebrate her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She vows to get stronger to make her beloved shopkeepers proud.
